sloka: या ते नरपते वृत्तिः भरते लक्ष्मणे च या ।सुग्रीवे च अंगदे राजन् ताम् चिंतयितुम् अर्हसि ॥४-१८-५४॥
transliteration: yā te narapate vṛttiḥ bharate lakṣmaṇe ca yā ।sugrīve ca aṁgade rājan tām ciṁtayitum arhasi ॥4-18-54॥

translations.english: 'Shower equal affection from your heart on Sugriva and Angada. You are their protector and punisher also. You know what should and should not be done.
